Input Values and Data Flow

Choose a value source

Source Purpose Example
Fixed value Enter a literal value 3.3
Variable Use a workflow variable voltage
Previous step result Use an earlier visible step's result Measure reading
Calculation Arithmetic, comparison or rounding voltage × 2
Elapsed time Elapsed run time 10.5 seconds
Timestamp Date and time during the run 2026-10-12T23:24:10.123+08:00

Previous step result offers earlier Tool Actions, BG Get Latest / Wait Next / Get Command Result / Get Buffer Data / Get Buffer Status, and String / Byte / Array Process results. Usually choose a named result from the dropdown; use the custom JSON Pointer (data path) only for other fields.

Calculation uses two operands for arithmetic/comparison and one for Round, Floor, Ceil and Trunc. Round half values away from zero; Trunc removes fractions toward zero.

Measure -> Set Variable: voltage -> Output: voltage
  3.3 V           3.3                   3.3

This is an example of data flow, not an actual measurement.

Data types and comparisons

Set Variable steps create or update variables. Fixed value supports Number, String, Boolean, and Null. Boolean uses the True / False selection; Null needs no value field. String "true" and "null" are text, not Boolean or Null. A Previous step result can refer only to a step that is earlier and visible in the current lexical scope. Calculations use arithmetic and comparison operators. Assert, While, and If offer ==, !=, >, >=, <, and <=. Their Fixed value operands support Number, String, Boolean, and Null. Equality compares JSON values without type coercion, with case-sensitive strings; arithmetic and ordering comparisons require numbers. A missing variable or result path is an error, not Null. A Calculation is not an arbitrary nested expression tree.

Elapsed time and timestamps

For an Output with Elapsed time, Time Format offers Seconds (default), Minutes:Seconds, Hours:Minutes:Seconds, and Days (Decimal). Minutes and hours accumulate beyond 60 minutes and 24 hours. Output Data shows three decimal places for seconds and nine for decimal days. For example, 90061.123 seconds displays as 1501:01.123, 25:01:01.123, or 1.042374109 d.

For a Timestamp Output, Include Date and Include UTC Offset default to enabled, displaying 2026-10-12T23:24:10.123+08:00. Disable either option to hide its portion. This affects display only; the full date/time remains stored in fixed UTC+08:00, including across midnight. These settings belong to each Output and survive Template save/load and step copy/paste. Changing Value Source clears the old time settings. Set Variable and Tool Action time sources are unchanged.

Include values in output data

An Output step is what creates a ResultRow column. Values used as inputs do not become result columns merely because they were referenced.

An Array returned by a Step can be stored as a Variable and used by Array Process; no manual fixed Array editor is provided. Use a dynamic Index in Get Item.
